<!--
============================================================================
SECTION 3: CIS READINESS × ACCESS/IMPLEMENTATION INTERSECTION
============================================================================
This file analyzes the intersection between CIS readiness and digital/media
access (TV, internet, cellphone). It identifies regions where CIS capacity
exists but communication channels may limit uptake, and vice versa.

Data Sources:
- CIS_access.parquet: Digital access percentages at admin levels
- Section 1 cisData: CIS readiness indicators (reused)
============================================================================
-->

# CIS Implementation {#cis-implementation}

{{< prose reach-at-scale level=2 >}}

```{ojs}
// Access data stops at admin 1 (s3View), so no district control here. Omitting
// the level cannot affect the sections that do render it — the state is per level.
adminControls(0, 1)
```

```{ojs}
// Query access data with SQL-side admin filtering (shared helper from Section 2)
s3AccessDataRaw = {
  const bind = createSqlBindings();
  const adminWhere = sqlAdminWhere(
    { admin0: selectedAdmin0, admin1: selectedAdmin1 },
    bind,
    { maxLevel: 1, iso3: iso3Set },
  );

  return await db.query(
    `
    SELECT *
    FROM access_data
    WHERE ${adminWhere}
  `,
    bind.params,
  );
}

// Access data reaches admin 1 only, so this section's view and its query both stop
// there: drilling into districts draws the regions with the selection outlined
// rather than emptying the map.
s3View = adminViewFor(1)

// Readiness has to be read at the same level as the access rows. filteredData is
// the full-depth query, so at district level it holds many admin-2 rows per region
// and indexing it by region would pick an arbitrary district's value.
s3Readiness = {
  const bind = createSqlBindings();
  const adminWhere = sqlAdminWhere(
    { admin0: selectedAdmin0, admin1: selectedAdmin1 },
    bind,
    { maxLevel: 1, iso3: iso3Set },
  );

  return await db.query(
    `SELECT * FROM cis_data WHERE ${adminWhere}`,
    bind.params,
  );
}

s3ReadinessByAdmin = new Map(
  s3Readiness.map((d) => [s3View.adminKey(d), d]),
)


section3Data = {
  return s3AccessDataRaw.map(access => {
    // Match CIS readiness at the same admin level as the access row.
    const cis = s3ReadinessByAdmin.get(s3View.adminKey(access));
    if (!cis) return null;
    
    // Calculate combined access: average of available indicators
    // This provides a single "overall access" metric
    // d3.mean skips null and NaN, and returns undefined for an all-missing set.
    const combined_access =
      d3.mean([access.tv, access.internet, access.cellphone]) ?? null;
    
    return {
      // Rows are regions once a country is picked, so they need their own label:
      // keying charts and tables on admin0_name collapsed every region of a
      // country onto one row.
      label: adminDisplayName(access, s3View.level),
      admin0_name: access.admin0_name,
      admin1_name: access.admin1_name,
      admin2_name: access.admin2_name,
      iso3: access.iso3,
      gaul0_code: access.gaul0_code,
      gaul1_code: access.gaul1_code,
      gaul2_code: access.gaul2_code,
      cis_readiness_index: cis.cis_readiness_index,
      // Raw access percentages (0-100 scale)
      tv_pct: access.tv,
      internet_pct: access.internet,
      cellphone_pct: access.cellphone,
      combined_pct: combined_access,
    };
  }).filter(d => d !== null);
}
```

```{ojs}
// The access types, their columns and their labels in one place. Insertion order
// is the display order for the radio. Depends on nbText, so the labels follow
// the language toggle.
S3_ACCESS_TYPES = new Object({
  combined: { pct: "combined_pct", label: nbText.s3AccessCombined },
  internet: { pct: "internet_pct", label: nbText.s3AccessInternet },
  tv: { pct: "tv_pct", label: nbText.s3AccessTV },
  cellphone: { pct: "cellphone_pct", label: nbText.s3AccessCellphone },
})

// Access is stored once, as a percentage. Comparing it to the readiness index or
// to the tercile cutoffs needs the same 0-1 scale, so that is derived here rather
// than held as a second copy of every column.
s3AccessNorm = (d, key = s3AccessType) => {
  const pct = d[S3_ACCESS_TYPES[key].pct];
  return pct == null || isNaN(pct) ? null : pct / 100;
}

s3CurrentAccessLabel = S3_ACCESS_TYPES[s3AccessType].label
```

```{ojs}
s3AccessCutoffs = {
  // Extract values for the currently selected access type
  const values = section3Data
    .map((d) => s3AccessNorm(d))
    .filter(v => v !== null && !isNaN(v))
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
  
  if (values.length === 0) {
    return { low: 0.33, moderate: 0.67 };
  }
  
  // Calculate tercile cutoffs (33.3% and 66.7% quantiles)
  return {
    low: d3.quantile(values, 0.333),
    moderate: d3.quantile(values, 0.667)
  };
}
```

```{ojs}
classifyS3Readiness = (value, rowOrLevel = s3View.level) =>
  classifyThreshold("cis_readiness_index", value, rowOrLevel);

function bivariateClassifyAccess(readiness, access, accessCutoffs, rowOrLevel = s3View.level) {
  const readinessClass = classifyS3Readiness(readiness, rowOrLevel);

  // Classify access level (using dynamic tercile cutoffs)
  let accessClass;
  if (access === null || isNaN(access)) accessClass = "N/A";
  else if (access < accessCutoffs.low) accessClass = "Low";
  else if (access < accessCutoffs.moderate) accessClass = "Moderate";
  else accessClass = "High";
  
  // Either axis missing means there is no cell on the 3x3 grid, so both fall to the
  // one key the palette actually has. Composing "No data × High" produced a class
  // with no colour.
  const missing = accessClass === "N/A" || readinessClass === "No data";

  return {
    readinessClass,
    accessClass,
    bivariateClass: missing ? "N/A" : `${readinessClass} × ${accessClass}`,
  };
}

// Bivariate color palette (reused from Section 2 for consistency)
// Section 2's palette plus the missing-access key. Sharing the object keeps the
// two bivariate maps from drifting apart.
s3BivariateColors = ({ ...bivariateColors, "N/A": "#cccccc" })

```

```{ojs}
// Process data with bivariate classification
s3ProcessedData = {
  return section3Data.map(d => {
    const accessValue = s3AccessNorm(d);
    const classification = bivariateClassifyAccess(
      d.cis_readiness_index,
      accessValue,
      s3AccessCutoffs,
      d
    );
    
    return {
      ...d,
      accessValue,
      ...classification,
      // Needs both terms: subtracting a null readiness coerces it to 0 and reports
      // the access value itself as the gap.
      gap:
        Number.isFinite(accessValue) &&
        Number.isFinite(d.cis_readiness_index)
          ? accessValue - d.cis_readiness_index
          : null,
    };
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
// Sort data based on selected metric
s3SortedData = {
  if (!s3ProcessedData || s3ProcessedData.length === 0) {
    return [];
  }
  
  const data = [...s3ProcessedData];
  
  const value =
    s3SortBy === "readiness"
      ? (d) => d.cis_readiness_index
      : (d) => s3AccessNorm(d, s3SortBy);

  return data.sort((a, b) => (value(b) || 0) - (value(a) || 0));
}
```

```{ojs}
// Prepare geographic data for map - dynamically show admin levels based on selection
// Use the master admin selectors (selectedAdmin0, etc.) for consistency with other sections
s3GeoData = ({
  type: "FeatureCollection",
  // Units with no access data are dropped rather than drawn faded.
  features: buildLevelFeatures(
    (row) => ({ ...(row || {}), hasData: Boolean(row) }),
    s3ProcessedData,
    s3View,
  ).filter((f) => f.properties.hasData),
})
```

```{ojs}
// Section 3 Map Display (Handles both Bivariate and Univariate)
function renderS3MapDisplay() {
  if (s3ViewType !== "map") return null;

  if (s3MapType === "univariate") {
    return createS3AccessMap();
  } else {
    return bivariateMapWithLegend(createS3BivariateMap(), {
      colors: s3BivariateColors,
      yLabel: s3CurrentAccessLabel,
    });
  }
}

// Access Map (Univariate)
function createS3AccessMap() {
  return makeChoropleth({
    features: s3GeoData,
    width: 775,
    height: 610,
    projection: "mercator",
    fill: (d) => d.properties.accessValue,
    color: {
      type: "linear",
      domain: [0, 1],
      scheme: "Blues",
      label: s3CurrentAccessLabel,
    },
    channels: {
      region: {
        label:
          s3View.level === 2
            ? "District"
            : s3View.level === 1
              ? "Region"
              : "Country",
        value: (d) =>
          d.properties.regionName || d.properties.admin0_name || "N/A",
      },
      access: {
        label: s3CurrentAccessLabel,
        value: (d) =>
          d.properties.accessValue != null
            ? `${(d.properties.accessValue * 100).toFixed(1)}%`
            : "N/A",
      },
    },
    tooltip: {
      region: true,
      access: true,
    },
    adminHighlight: highlightFor(s3View),
  });
}

// Section 3 bivariate map with diamond legend (matching Section 2 style)
function createS3BivariateMap() {
  if (s3ViewType !== "map") return null;

  return makeChoropleth({
    features: s3GeoData,
    width: 775,
    height: 610,
    fill: (d) => d.properties.bivariateClass,
    color: {
      type: "categorical",
      legend: false,
      domain: Object.keys(s3BivariateColors),
      range: Object.values(s3BivariateColors),
      label: "Bivariate Class",
    },
    channels: {
      region: {
        label:
          s3View.level === 2
            ? "District"
            : s3View.level === 1
              ? "Region"
              : "Country",
        value: (d) =>
          d.properties.regionName || d.properties.admin0_name || "N/A",
      },
      readiness: {
        label: nbText.s3ReadinessLabel,
        value: (d) =>
          fmt(d.properties.cis_readiness_index, 2),
      },
      readinessClass: {
        label: "Readiness Class",
        value: (d) => d.properties.readinessClass || "N/A",
      },
      access: {
        label: s3CurrentAccessLabel,
        value: (d) =>
          d.properties.accessValue != null
            ? `${(d.properties.accessValue * 100).toFixed(1)}%`
            : "N/A",
      },
      accessClass: {
        label: "Access Class",
        value: (d) => d.properties.accessClass || "N/A",
      },
      category: {
        label: "Category",
        value: (d) => d.properties.bivariateClass || "N/A",
      },
    },
    tooltip: {
      region: true,
      readiness: true,
      readinessClass: true,
      access: true,
      accessClass: true,
      category: true,
    },
    adminHighlight: highlightFor(s3View),
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
function renderS3DumbbellLegend() {
  const items = [
    {symbol: "●", color: "#377eb8", label: nbText.s3ReadinessLabel},
    {symbol: "●", color: "#ff7f00", label: s3CurrentAccessLabel},
    {symbol: "━", color: "#4daf4a", label: nbText.s3PositiveGap},
    {symbol: "━", color: "#e41a1c", label: nbText.s3NegativeGap},
    {symbol: "━", color: "#999999", label: "Similar values"}
  ];

  return html`<div style="margin-bottom: 10px; padding: 10px; background: #f8f9fa; border-radius: 5px;">
    <div style="display: flex; gap: 20px; align-items: center; font-size: 12px;">
      ${items.map(({symbol, color, label}) => html`
        <div><span style="color: ${color};">${symbol}</span> ${label}</div>
      `)}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

function makeS3DumbbellTip() {
  return {
    fontSize: 14,
    channels: {
      area: { label: "Area", value: (d) => d.label },
      readiness: { label: nbText.s3ReadinessLabel, value: d => d.cis_readiness_index },
      access: { label: s3CurrentAccessLabel, value: d => d.accessValue },
      gap: { label: nbText.s3GapLabel, value: d => d.gap }
    },
    format: {
      country: true,
      x: false,
      y: false,
      readiness: d => fmt(d, 3),
      access: d => d != null ? `${(d * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : "N/A",
      gap: (d) => {
        if (d == null || isNaN(d)) return "N/A";
        const label = d > 0 ? nbText.s3PositiveGap : nbText.s3NegativeGap
        return `${d.toFixed(3)} (${label})`;
      }
    }
  };
}

function renderS3DumbbellPlot(data) {
  const chartHeight = Math.max(600, data.length * 25);
  const dataWithAccess = data.filter(d => d.accessValue !== null && !isNaN(d.accessValue));
  const labels = data.map((d) => d.label);
  const axis = labelAxis(labels, 1200);
  const xDomain = d3.extent([
    ...data.map(d => d.cis_readiness_index || 0),
    ...data.map(d => d.accessValue || 0)
  ]);
  const tip = makeS3DumbbellTip();

  return Plot.plot({
    style: chartStyle,
    width: 1200,
    height: chartHeight,
    marginLeft: axis.marginLeft,
    marginRight: 50,
    marginTop: 80,
    marginBottom: 80,
    x: {
      domain: xDomain,
      label: "Value",
      grid: true,
      axis: "top"
    },
    y: {
      label: null,
      domain: labels,
      tickFormat: axis.tickFormat
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.axisX({anchor: "bottom", label: "Value"}),
      Plot.link(dataWithAccess, {
        x1: "cis_readiness_index",
        x2: "accessValue",
        y1: "label",
        y2: "label",
        stroke: (d) => {
          if (d.gap == null || isNaN(d.gap)) return "#999999";
          return d.gap > 0.05 ? "#4daf4a" : d.gap < -0.05 ? "#e41a1c" : "#999999";
        },
        strokeWidth: 2
      }),
      Plot.dot(data, {
        x: "cis_readiness_index",
        y: "label",
        fill: "#377eb8",
        r: 5,
        tip: {
          ...tip,
          format: {
            ...tip.format,
            x: d => `Readiness: ${fmt(d, 3)}`
          }
        }
      }),
      Plot.dot(dataWithAccess, {
        x: "accessValue",
        y: "label",
        fill: "#ff7f00",
        r: 5,
        stroke: "#ff7f00",
        strokeWidth: 2,
        tip
      })
    ]
  });
}

function renderS3DumbbellView() {
  return html`<div style="width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">
    ${renderS3DumbbellLegend()}
    ${renderS3DumbbellPlot(s3SortedData)}
    ${renderS3DumbbellLegend()}
    <div style="margin-top: 10px;">
      ${s3DownloadButton}
    </div>
  </div>`;
}

function renderS3TableView() {
  return filterableDataTable(s3SortedData, {
    // Columns, headers and formats all come off the one registry, so they cannot
    // drift apart, and the access headers follow the language toggle.
    //TODO: the remaining literals here are English-only, like most of this
    // section's widget labels — they need keys in data/cis/text/<locale>.json.
    columns: [
      "label",
      "iso3",
      "cis_readiness_index",
      "readinessClass",
      ...Object.values(S3_ACCESS_TYPES).map((type) => type.pct),
      "gap",
    ],
    header: {
      label: "Area",
      iso3: "ISO3",
      cis_readiness_index: "CIS Readiness (Raw)",
      readinessClass: "CIS Class",
      ...Object.fromEntries(
        Object.values(S3_ACCESS_TYPES).map((type) => [
          type.pct,
          `${type.label} (%)`,
        ]),
      ),
      gap: nbText.s3GapLabel,
    },
    format: {
      cis_readiness_index: (d) => fmt(d, 3),
      gap: (d) => fmt(d, 3),
      ...Object.fromEntries(
        Object.values(S3_ACCESS_TYPES).map((type) => [
          type.pct,
          (d) => fmt(d, 1),
        ]),
      ),
    },
    width: {
      label: 150,
      iso3: 60
    }
  });
}

// Render based on view type
{
  if (s3ViewType === "map") {
    return html`<div style="width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;">
      ${renderS3MapDisplay()}
    </div>`;
  } else if (s3ViewType === "dumbbell") {
    return renderS3DumbbellView();
  }
  return renderS3TableView();
}
```

```{ojs}
// Define Download button separately to be used in multiple places
s3DownloadButton = {
    // Helper function to safely format numbers
    const safeFormat = (value, decimals) => {
      if (value == null || isNaN(value)) return "N/A";
      return value.toFixed(decimals);
    };
    
    return downloadCsvButton(
      s3SortedData.map(d => ({
        "Area": d.label || "N/A",
        "ISO3": d.iso3 || "N/A",
        "CIS Readiness Raw": safeFormat(d.cis_readiness_index, 3),
        "CIS Readiness Class": d.readinessClass || "N/A",
        "TV Access %": safeFormat(d.tv_pct, 1),
        "Internet Access %": safeFormat(d.internet_pct, 1),
        "Cellphone Access %": safeFormat(d.cellphone_pct, 1),
        "Combined Access %": safeFormat(d.combined_pct, 1),
        "Gap (Access - Readiness)": safeFormat(d.gap, 3),
        "Bivariate Category": d.bivariateClass || "N/A"
      })),
  { filename: `cis_implementation_${s3AccessType}_access`, label: nbText.downloadLabel },
);
}
```

```{ojs}
s3Insights = {
  const avgReadiness = d3.mean(section3Data, d => d.cis_readiness_index);
  const avgAccess = d3.mean(section3Data, (d) => s3AccessNorm(d));
  
  // Find countries with high readiness but low access (capacity-access gap)
  const capacityGaps = s3ProcessedData.filter(d => 
    d.cis_readiness_index > 0.6 && d.accessValue !== null && !isNaN(d.accessValue) && d.accessValue < 0.4
  );
  
  // Find optimal zones (high readiness + high access)
  const optimalZones = s3ProcessedData.filter(d => 
    d.bivariateClass === "High × High"
  );
  
  // Use breadcrumb from master admin selectors for consistent region naming
  // breadcrumb is defined in _cis_readiness_index.qmd and reflects the current admin selection
  const selectedRegion = breadcrumb || "Sub-Saharan Africa";
  
  const insight1 = `In ${selectedRegion}, average CIS Readiness is **${avgReadiness.toFixed(2)}** while ${s3CurrentAccessLabel} averages **${(avgAccess * 100).toFixed(1)}%**.`;
  
  const insight2 = capacityGaps.length > 0 
    ? `Countries such as **${capacityGaps.slice(0, 2).map(d => d.label).join(' and ')}** show strong technical capacity but limited digital reach, highlighting the need for investment in ICT and communication channels to deliver CIS to users.`
    : 'Most countries show balanced capacity and access.';
  
  const insight3 = optimalZones.length > 0
    ? `**${optimalZones.length} countries** (${(optimalZones.length / s3ProcessedData.length * 100).toFixed(1)}%) fall in the optimal zone with both high CIS readiness and high ${s3CurrentAccessLabel.toLowerCase()}, representing prime opportunities for scaling climate services.`
    : `No countries currently fall in the optimal zone for ${s3CurrentAccessLabel.toLowerCase()}.`;
  
  return html`
    <div style="background: #f8f9fa; padding: 20px; border-radius: 8px; margin-top: 20px;">
      <h4 style="margin-top: 0;">Key Insights</h4>
      <p style="margin: 10px 0;">${md([insight1])}</p>
      <p style="margin: 10px 0;"><strong>${nbText.s3CapacityGap}:</strong> ${md([insight2])}</p>
      <p style="margin: 10px 0;"><strong>Optimal Zones:</strong> ${md([insight3])}</p>
    </div>
  `;
}
```
